about.title: Ortho について
about.subtitle: ミッションと目的
about.missionTitle: Ortho ミッションステートメント
about.missionStrong: 私たちの使命は、言語・通貨・背景に関係なく、誰にとっても個人の資産管理をシンプルで分かりやすく、利用しやすいものにすることです。
about.missionBody: お金を理解するために、スプレッドシートや難しい金融用語、高額なアドバイザーは不要であるべきだと私たちは考えます。Orthoは、丁寧なデザインとAIを組み合わせることで、お金の流れを可視化し、より良い意思決定と長期的な安定につなげます。
about.committedItem1: ユーザーがデータを完全に所有できること
about.committedItem2: 多言語・多通貨の家庭をサポートすること
about.committedItem3: カップルや家族が一緒にお金を管理できるようにすること
about.committedItem4: お金の不安や混乱を明確さに変えること
about.noBackendBody: Orthoは従来型のバックエンドを使いません。Googleでサインインし、データはあなた自身のGoogle Sheetsに保存されます。つまり、データの主導権は常にあなたにあります。私たちはあなたの金融記録を自社サーバーに保持しません。
about.exportBody: データはいつでもPDF、JSONファイル、安全なエクスポート文字列として書き出しでき、必要なときに再インポートできます。あなたの情報は持ち運び可能で柔軟、そして常にあなたのものです。
about.futureBody: 今後も、世界中のより多くの人が自然な形で家計管理できるよう、対応言語と通貨を継続的に拡張していきます。
about.closingStrong: あなたのデータはあなたのもの。お金はより明確に。未来はあなたの手の中に。
about.supportBody: Orthoがお役に立っているなら、サポートが継続的な改善につながります。

dashboard.title: Dashboard overview
dashboard.description: This page gives a month-level summary of financial health. Review KPI cards, trend charts, debt snapshot, expense by owner, source breakdown, owner transfers, recent activity, and insights.

dashboardSettings.title: Dashboard settings sheet
dashboardSettings.description: Open settings to control how dashboard math is calculated: household vs individual owner, selected month, included expense scope, and whether debt payments are counted in spend.

transactions.title: Transactions table
transactions.description: This page lists expense and owner transfer rows by month. Use sorting and search to inspect records, and review visible totals for the current filtered view.

transactionsAdd.title: New expense sheet
transactionsAdd.description: Use this sheet to add one or many expense or transfer rows in one submit. Each row supports source, date, amount, category, ownership, and split/allocation controls.

transactionsFilters.title: Filters and actions sheet
transactionsFilters.description: Use this sheet to filter by month, source, category, owner, and type. It also controls whether owner transfers are included in totals for the current transaction view.

income.title: Income table
income.description: This page groups all income entries by month with totals. It is the source for dashboard income calculations and supports row-level edits and deletes.

incomeAdd.title: Income sheet
incomeAdd.description: Add income records with date, amount, description, category, and owner. Accurate entries here directly affect net cash flow and monthly comparisons.

debt.title: Debt table
debt.description: This page tracks each debt balance and payment history. Balances are derived from initial amount minus payments and feed debt snapshot metrics on dashboard.

debtAdd.title: Debt sheets
debtAdd.description: Use the debt sheets to create debts and record payments. Payment rows reduce outstanding balance and can be included in dashboard spend depending on settings.

mortgage.title: Mortgage table
mortgage.description: This page tracks mortgage payment entries separately from the transaction list. Those entries are available for dashboard spend metrics based on scope settings.

mortgageAdd.title: Mortgage sheet
mortgageAdd.description: Add mortgage payments with date, amount, and owner. Consistent entries here keep mortgage totals and owner-level calculations accurate.

presets.title: Presets table
presets.description: Presets are reusable templates for fast transaction entry. They store source, description, optional amount, category, and owner defaults.

presetsAdd.title: Preset sheet
presetsAdd.description: Use this sheet to create or edit a preset template. Presets speed up transaction entry and keep category/owner naming consistent.

data.title: Data page
data.description: This page handles import and export. You can import supported files and export your records as PDF, JSON, or export string for portability and backup.

settings.title: Settings page
settings.description: Settings controls categories, owners, theme, language, currency, sync behavior, and Google Sheets linking. Use it to define app-wide behavior and data governance.

dashboardKpis.title: Dashboard KPIs
dashboardKpis.description: These KPI cards summarize the selected month: net cash flow, total spend, total income, and outstanding debt. They are the quickest high-level read of current financial status.

dashboardTrends.title: Trend charts
dashboardTrends.description: These charts explain momentum over time. Income vs expenses compares inflows and outflows by month, while net cash flow trend shows whether each month finished positive or negative.

dashboardPies.title: Breakdown charts
dashboardPies.description: These donut charts break spending into categories and owner split. Use them to quickly understand spending composition and shared-vs-individual contribution patterns.

dashboardExpenseByOwner.title: Expense by owner section
dashboardExpenseByOwner.description: This section shows owner-level gross spend, transfer impact, and net after transfers. Expand rows to inspect per-transaction contributions used in owner-mode accounting.

dashboardDebtSnapshot.title: Debt snapshot section
dashboardDebtSnapshot.description: Debt Snapshot lists active debts, remaining balances, and progress bars toward payoff. It uses initial amount minus recorded payments from the debt module.

dashboardSpendBySource.title: Spend by card source section
dashboardSpendBySource.description: This section totals spending by source (manual and cards). It helps identify where spending is concentrated across payment channels.

dashboardOwnerTransfers.title: Owner transfers section
dashboardOwnerTransfers.description: Owner Transfers lists transfer entries for the selected month and shows the month total. These transfers affect owner net values but do not change household spend.

dashboardRecentActivity.title: Recent activity section
dashboardRecentActivity.description: Recent Activity surfaces the latest expense records for quick review. It is useful for spotting recently logged items and validating category/owner assignments.

dashboardInsights.title: Smart insights section
dashboardInsights.description: Smart Insights and Alerts highlight notable conditions such as spending shifts, missing income, or unpaid obligations, based on current dataset and dashboard scope.
